newsitem.title: UK: Redland details new Braas roofing jv plans.
newsitem.headline: Redland details new Braas roofing jv plans.

text.p: British-based building products group Redland Plc said that detailed plans for the reorganisation and merger of its European roofing interests with those of its German associate company Braas would result in Redland receiving a cash payment of 220 million stg from Braas.

"Redland intends to use the 220 milion stg cash payment in the medium term to provide the financial resources to strengthen Redland's existing aggregates operations and to invest in growth opportunities in both roofing and aggregates in the developing markets of the world," the company said in a statement.
The company said that all the details of the plan, as originally announced in April, had been confirmed in agreements to implement the reorganisation which have now been signed.
The next step will be to seek the agreement of the minority shareholders in Braas, in which Redland currently has a 50.76 percent stake, some of whom hold more than 10 percent of the German company.
As a result of the regulatory issues raised by this, Redland plans to call an extraordinary general meeting for November 27.
